pair.title: Pair {name}
pair.description:
Panel {name} ({address}) – current pairing state: **{pairing_state}**.

1. Close the Truma iNet X app on all phones completely (also in the background). The panel accepts only one app connection.
2. On the panel tap **App** in the main menu and follow the instructions on the display (Bluetooth pairing becomes active, no code is shown).
3. Click *Submit* right away. Home Assistant waits up to 30 s for *pairing active*, then pairs without a code (Just Works) and registers at the panel.

Only fill in the PIN if your panel really shows a code. If Home Assistant is already paired (e.g. via `bluetoothctl`), tick *Already paired*.

Last error detail: {detail}

data.legacy_pairing: Legacy pairing (Secure Connections off during pairing, recommended)
data.passkey: PIN (only if the panel shows one)

data_description.legacy_pairing: Temporarily switches the Bluetooth adapter to LE legacy pairing like `btmgmt sc off`, restored afterwards.
data_description.passkey: Leave empty – the iNet X panel normally pairs without a code.

error.invalid_passkey: The PIN must consist of up to 6 digits.
error.passkey_required: The panel asked for a PIN. Enter the code shown on the panel.
error.wrong_passkey: Pairing was rejected – wrong PIN or pairing mode expired.
error.pairing_timeout: Pairing timed out. Is the panel in pairing mode?
error.agent_failed: Could not register a Bluetooth pairing agent.
error.dbus_unavailable: The Bluetooth stack (BlueZ/D-Bus) is not reachable.
error.device_not_local: The panel is not known to the local Bluetooth adapter.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the panel.
error.no_registration: The panel did not accept the registration (is it paired?).
error.pairing_not_active: The panel does not report *pairing active*. Tap *App* in the panel main menu and submit again.
error.other_phone_connected: Another smartphone is connected to the panel. Close the iNet X app on all phones (also in the background).
error.pairing_rejected: The panel rejected the pairing. Re-activate pairing on the panel and try again.
